partners.name: Wellcome Collection
partners.rights: Rights vary by record and media
partners.contact: Existing Orbis email thread; do not cold-email
partners.subject: Akashic Records — collection access and collaboration enquiry
partners.email:
Hello Wellcome Collection team,

Thank you for the guidance your team has already provided about manuscript research. We are expanding our catalogue work and would appreciate advice on full snapshots and rights metadata.

I am developing the Akashic Records, an early-stage independent knowledge library intended to connect cited records across disciplines while crediting custodians and directing readers back to their original collections.

Would you be willing to direct me to the appropriate person or documentation for catalogue exports or APIs, update schedules, attribution, and separate permissions for preservation, display and commercial reuse? We are not seeking ownership of your materials or suggesting an existing partnership.

I'd also be interested in what your institution would value most from a potential collaboration.

Thank you for the work you do to preserve knowledge.

Colin Hurst Bullock
Founder, Akashic Records
